name: Ww3
overview: Scripture reveals that global conflict, including wars and rumors of wars, will mark the times preceding Christ's return, as Jesus warns in Matthew 24:6 and Ezekiel 38:1 records God’s sovereign word concerning future events. These tumultuous days will be severe, yet God will shorten them for the sake of His elect, assuring their preservation (Matthew 24:22). Believers are exhorted to remain vigilant and prayerful, seeking to stand worthy before the Son of Man (Luke 21:36), while trusting in God's ultimate plan and love demonstrated through Christ, who offers eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16). Though the exact timing is known only by the Father (Matthew 24:36), the certainty of these events calls for steadfast faith and readiness.
